meaning_cn: 双刃剑（利弊兼有的事物）
example: The internet is a double-edged sword for education.
example_cn: 互联网对教育来说是一把双刃剑。

example: The government attaches great importance to environmental protection.
example_cn: 政府高度重视环境保护。

example: Technology is bound to change the way we work.
example_cn: 科技必然改变我们的工作方式。

example: Children today are exposed to screens from an early age.
example_cn: 现在的孩子很小就接触到屏幕。

example: She is keen on learning foreign languages.
example_cn: 她热衷于学习外语。

example: Overworked employees are prone to stress-related illness.
example_cn: 过度劳累的员工容易患上压力相关的疾病。

example: Online courses help bridge the gap between rural and urban education.
example_cn: 在线课程有助于弥合城乡教育差距。

example: Globalisation has brought about significant cultural changes.
example_cn: 全球化带来了显著的文化变化。

example: Travelling abroad broadens one's horizons.
example_cn: 出国旅行能开阔眼界。

example: By and large, the new policy has been well received.
example_cn: 总体而言，新政策反响良好。

example: The programme caters to students of all levels.
example_cn: 这个课程满足各水平学生的需求。

example: Scientists came up with a cheaper way to purify water.
example_cn: 科学家想出了一种更便宜的净水方法。

example: Cities must cope with growing traffic congestion.
example_cn: 城市必须应对日益严重的交通拥堵。

example: You can count on public transport during peak hours in big cities.
example_cn: 在大城市高峰时段可以依靠公共交通。

example: We should cut down on single-use plastics.
example_cn: 我们应该减少使用一次性塑料。

example: The tradition dates back to the 18th century.
example_cn: 这个传统可以追溯到18世纪。

example: The flight was delayed due to heavy fog.
example_cn: 航班因大雾延误。

example: Many students end up choosing majors they later regret.
example_cn: 许多学生最终选择了日后后悔的专业。

example: Social media exerts a profound influence on young people.
example_cn: 社交媒体对年轻人产生深远影响。

example: It took me a while to figure out the answer.
example_cn: 我花了一会儿才弄明白答案。

example: The city gives priority to public transport over private cars.
example_cn: 该市优先发展公共交通而非私家车。

example: Rapid urbanisation gives rise to housing shortages.
example_cn: 快速城市化导致了住房短缺。

example: Students in remote areas now have access to online libraries.
example_cn: 偏远地区的学生现在可以访问在线图书馆。

example: The building was designed in accordance with safety regulations.
example_cn: 这座建筑是按照安全规定设计的。

example: In contrast to his brother, he prefers working alone.
example_cn: 与他哥哥相反，他更喜欢独自工作。

example: Most residents voted in favour of the new park.
example_cn: 大多数居民投票支持新公园。

example: The rules were revised in light of recent research.
example_cn: 根据最近的研究，规则被修订了。

example: In terms of cost, cycling is unbeatable.
example_cn: 就成本而言，骑行无可匹敌。

example: Investing in education pays off in the long run.
example_cn: 从长远来看，投资教育是有回报的。

example: Laws struggle to keep pace with technological change.
example_cn: 法律难以跟上技术变革的步伐。

example: The school lays emphasis on critical thinking.
example_cn: 这所学校强调批判性思维。

example: Primary education lays a solid foundation for lifelong learning.
example_cn: 小学教育为终身学习奠定坚实基础。

example: I look forward to hearing from you.
example_cn: 我期待收到你的回复。

meaning_cn: 收支相抵；勉强维持生计
example: Many families struggle to make ends meet in big cities.
example_cn: 大城市里许多家庭难以维持生计。

example: Make the most of your time at university.
example_cn: 充分利用你的大学时光。

example: More often than not, careful planning saves time.
example_cn: 周密的计划通常能节省时间。

example: I am speaking on behalf of the whole class.
example_cn: 我代表全班发言。

example: The plan was rejected on the grounds that it was too costly.
example_cn: 该计划因成本过高而被否决。

example: Building a second airport is out of the question for now.
example_cn: 目前再建一座机场是不可能的。

example: Employers pay attention to practical skills as well as degrees.
example_cn: 雇主既看重学位也关注实践技能。

example: Teachers play a pivotal role in shaping young minds.
example_cn: 教师在塑造年轻人思想方面起关键作用。

example: The committee put forward several proposals.
example_cn: 委员会提出了几项建议。

example: The course is open to everyone regardless of age.
example_cn: 该课程对所有人开放，不论年龄。

example: Lack of sleep results in poor concentration.
example_cn: 睡眠不足导致注意力不集中。

example: The world is slowly running out of fresh water.
example_cn: 世界的淡水资源正在慢慢耗尽。

example: Parents should set an example for their children.
example_cn: 父母应为孩子树立榜样。

example: The city has spared no effort to improve air quality.
example_cn: 该市不遗余力地改善空气质量。

example: Her creativity makes her stand out from other applicants.
example_cn: 她的创造力使她在众多申请者中脱颖而出。

example: Most traffic accidents stem from careless driving.
example_cn: 大多数交通事故源于粗心驾驶。

example: It is hard to strike a balance between work and family life.
example_cn: 在工作和家庭生活之间取得平衡很难。

example: Good policy takes the needs of minorities into account.
example_cn: 好的政策会考虑少数群体的需求。

example: Take advantage of the library's free resources.
example_cn: 充分利用图书馆的免费资源。

example: Successful learners take the initiative to ask questions.
example_cn: 成功的学习者会主动提问。

example: There is no denying that cities offer more job opportunities.
example_cn: 不可否认，城市提供更多就业机会。

example: To a certain extent, stress can improve performance.
example_cn: 在某种程度上，压力可以提高表现。

example: We cannot turn a blind eye to plastic pollution.
example_cn: 我们不能对塑料污染视而不见。

example: With the development of AI, many jobs are being transformed.
example_cn: 随着人工智能的发展，许多工作正在被改变。

example: Economic growth should not come at the expense of the environment.
example_cn: 经济增长不应以环境为代价。

phrase: as far as I am concerned
example: As far as I am concerned, reading beats watching videos.
example_cn: 就我而言，读书胜过看视频。

example: It goes without saying that health is more important than wealth.
example_cn: 不言而喻，健康比财富更重要。

example: The school banned phones in an attempt to improve focus.
example_cn: 学校为了提升专注度而禁用手机。

example: Keep the deadline in mind when planning your study schedule.
example_cn: 安排学习计划时要牢记截止日期。

example: The new stadium lives up to expectations.
example_cn: 新体育场不负众望。

example: We should not look down on manual workers.
example_cn: 我们不应轻视体力劳动者。

example: The programme provides students with hands-on experience.
example_cn: 该项目为学生提供实践经验。

example: Finishing a marathon gives you a real sense of achievement.
example_cn: 跑完马拉松会带给你真正的成就感。
